title: brassaiopsis polyacantha var. andamanica
intro: Brassaiopsis polyacantha var. andamanica, commonly known as the Andamanese Polyacanth, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of treating fever, inflammation, and pain due to its immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Brassaiopsis polyacantha var. andamanica include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
